messages:
Zoey Lin: quick thread \u2014 want to pilot a tiny PLG sprint next week: short launch post + lightning webinar (8m) + tiered engagement credits. goal = accelerate first-template success and surface high-value prompts faster.
Arman Gupta: short and focused. what's the one-line hypothesis?
Zoey Lin: hypothesis: pairing a tight benchmark narrative + an 8-min demo increases first-template-success within 48h compared to flat credits. credits reduce friction for trying templates.
Bea Torres: suggest 3 arms, N=420: (A) launch+webinar+$18 milestone on attend, (B) launch+$12 read credit, (C) control. run 10 days.
Kai Huang: routing rules? need to decide which signups see webinar invite. also cap seats.
Arman Gupta: rule idea: utm_campaign=lightning_webinar -> auto A, social_ad -> randomize A/B, organic -> random assign across arms. cap webinar at 260/week, overflow -> waitlist + $5 consolation.
Bea Torres: onboarding treatment for A: show a 3-card quick playbook with an inline "Run this" button after signup. flag name: mkt/lightning_playbook_v1. canary to 40.
ops-bot: created flag mkt/lightning_playbook_v1 (canary=40) :white_check_mark:
Kai Huang: tracking events: post_view, post_read, webinar_invited, webinar_rsvp, webinar_attended, playbook_shown, template_ran, milestone_credit_redeemed, first_success_response.
Zoey Lin: email cadence for A: invite, -24h reminder, -15m reminder, replay + redeem link. replay includes the benchmark highlight and one-click try.
Arman Gupta: metrics: pct_first_success_48h, day1_template_try_pct, week1_retention, avg_tokens_saved_per_use. add 48h early-alert on template_try_rate.
Bea Torres: quick config snippet below, ack with :thumbsup: if good.
```yaml
experiment_id: lightning_launch_2145
cohort_size: 420
arms:
  - name: launch_webinar_milestone
    webinar_invite: true
    milestone_credit_usd: 18
  - name: launch_read_credit
    webinar_invite: false
    read_credit_usd: 12
  - name: control
    webinar_invite: false
    read_credit_usd: 0
traffic_rules:
  - if: utm_campaign==lightning_webinar -> assign:launch_webinar_milestone
  - if: source==social -> random_assign(launch_webinar_milestone, launch_read_credit)
  - else: random_assign(all_arms)
metrics:
  - pct_first_success_48h
  - day1_template_try_pct
  - week1_retention
```
Arman Gupta: owners: landing & copy = Bea, emails = Zoey, FF + onboarding push = Kai, analytics = Arman, credits ops = finance-ops.
Bea Torres: timeline: landing + copy by Mon EOD, flag canary Tue AM, launch Wed AM. I'll prepare the benchmark blurb: short case stat + 2 bullets.
finance-ops: can you confirm credit provisioning and anti-abuse limits?
finance-ops: confirmed budget and redemption limits. will add promo throttles and fraud checks.
Zoey Lin: great. if no objections I'll book a 15-min runbook tomorrow 9:15 to finalize creatives and QA. :rocket:
